statusDetail: Atomic coverage complete: 58/58 checks judged across five representative paths.

page.framework: server-rendered MPA with bundled client JavaScript
page.notes: Public adult-media directory with masonry listings, performer profiles, navigation/search, third-party advertising and analytics.

checkOutcomes.method: screenshot under emulated prefers-color-scheme: dark plus computed-style probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: The dark-condition screenshot is pixel-identical to the light screenshot and html computes color-scheme: normal.

checkOutcomes.method: evaluate getAnimations() under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce
checkOutcomes.evidence: The emulated reduced-motion preference matched and the page exposed zero active animations.

checkOutcomes.method: forced-colors/prefers-contrast screenshot and Lighthouse contrast context
checkOutcomes.evidence: The forced-colors screenshot preserves visible text, links, controls, and media boundaries.

checkOutcomes.method: CSS/DOM feature probe across MPA routes
checkOutcomes.evidence: No view-transition CSS or cross-document transition rule is present; home-to-detail navigation swaps instantly.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM/CSS inspection for scroll-linked effects
checkOutcomes.evidence: No parallax, reveal, carousel, or other scroll-linked animation exists to implement.
checkOutcomes.reason: The representative templates contain no scroll-linked motion.

checkOutcomes.method: visual and DOM inspection of representative templates
checkOutcomes.evidence: The site exposes links, pagination, and menu/search toggles, but no swipe, drag, snap carousel, or gesture-driven control.

checkOutcomes.method: long-page screenshots and CSS feature probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: The page is 3,077 px tall on desktop and 5,296 px on mobile, but has no sticky/scroll-state-aware chrome or progress affordance.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM/CSS inspection for tooltips, popovers and floating menus
checkOutcomes.evidence: No tooltip, popover, or viewport-edge anchored overlay is present.
checkOutcomes.reason: There is no anchored overlay surface on the covered templates.

checkOutcomes.method: route walkthrough and transition/CSS probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: Navigating from the masonry listing to a performer detail uses an abrupt full-page swap with no focus/target cue or directional transition.

checkOutcomes.method: load screenshots at desktop/mobile and 404 state
checkOutcomes.evidence: No modal, consent wall, or full-viewport interstitial obscured core content in the captured load states.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM inspection of menu/search controls and overlay primitives
checkOutcomes.evidence: Mobile menu and search are custom button/div UI; there are no dialog, popover, or details elements and the buttons expose no expanded state.

checkOutcomes.method: first-viewport screenshots
checkOutcomes.evidence: On mobile, two unrelated dating ads occupy the band between navigation and the Top Pornstars heading, delaying the core listing.

checkOutcomes.method: layout at 360x800 plus screenshot
checkOutcomes.evidence: At 360 px, scrollWidth equals clientWidth (360), horizontal overflow is 0, and the masonry becomes two columns.

checkOutcomes.method: stylesheet feature probe and screenshots at 360/1440
checkOutcomes.evidence: Cards resize across viewports, but the live stylesheet exposes no @container rule or container-type for reusable cards.

checkOutcomes.method: programmatic focus and target-size probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: Focus receives a native outline, but pagination links are only 10–16 px wide and many card labels are 18 px high.

checkOutcomes.method: first-viewport screenshots and heading/link inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: Top Pornstars is a clear H1; Popular Videos, pagination, and performer cards expose the browse task immediately.

checkOutcomes.method: representative browse flow: home listing to performer detail
checkOutcomes.evidence: The listing exposes real performer hrefs and the selected TeannaTrump route returned 200 with profile statistics, posts, and pagination.

checkOutcomes.method: intentional 404 route screenshot and DOM probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: A missing URL returns HTTP 404 and presents a clear Not Found heading, explanation, and navigation back to site sections.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse plus CDP trace/layout
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 3.46 s (outside good <=2.5 s), CLS 0.069, and TBT 117.5 ms; trace LCP was 2.79 s.

checkOutcomes.method: desktop/mobile layout-shift observer and image audit
checkOutcomes.evidence: Desktop layout observed CLS 0.264, dominated by a 0.263 shift; all 34 images lack width/height.

checkOutcomes.method: CDP trace and layout long-task observers
checkOutcomes.evidence: The trace found zero long tasks and 0 ms total blocking time; both layout captures also reported no long tasks.

checkOutcomes.method: HAR summary confirmed against DOM/scripts and image audit
checkOutcomes.evidence: The page transfers 2.01 MB over 68 requests; 30 below-fold images are not lazy and 34 lack responsive sources.

checkOutcomes.method: HAR third-party/script breakdown plus Lighthouse
checkOutcomes.evidence: Scripts transfer 435 KB; Google Tag Manager alone transfers 282 KB and multiple ad/analytics bundles load before user interaction.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse accessibility audit and DOM form/control probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse found two icon-only buttons without names, an unnamed full-page ad link, and an untitled iframe; search controls also have no labels.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse contrast audit
checkOutcomes.evidence: Brand/navigation pink has contrast ratios 2.71:1 and 2.9:1 against light surfaces, below 4.5:1 for normal text.

checkOutcomes.method: landmark/heading and keyboard focus probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: The page has one H1 and visible native focus, but no header, nav, main, or footer landmarks despite substantial navigation and content.

checkOutcomes.method: desktop/mobile screenshots and computed text inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: Body and headings remain unclipped and readable in both layouts; content labels wrap without horizontal clipping.

checkOutcomes.method: narrow reflow, viewport and target-size probes
checkOutcomes.evidence: Reflow itself succeeds and user scaling is not disabled, but pagination and many labels are materially below recommended target dimensions.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse console audit and HAR status breakdown
checkOutcomes.evidence: A Twitter image request logs a 404 console error; the HAR also records one 404 resource.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM/doctype/charset and image audit
checkOutcomes.evidence: Doctype and UTF-8 are valid, but all 34 images omit explicit dimensions and 15 are over 2x their displayed width.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse deprecation and inspector audits
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse reports three deprecated API warnings plus DevTools inspector issues.

checkOutcomes.method: rendered and raw DOM metadata on home/detail
checkOutcomes.evidence: Home and performer detail pages have descriptive titles and a meta description, both present in raw HTML.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM link/viewport probe plus Lighthouse SEO
checkOutcomes.evidence: Viewport metadata exists and robots permits search, but the language control uses javascript:void(0), four anchors lack href, and many image links have no discernible text.

checkOutcomes.method: HTTP, robots, sitemap, canonical and hreflang inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: Pages return 200 and robots allows search, but home/detail expose no canonical or hreflang and /sitemap.xml returns 404.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM probe for JSON-LD/Open Graph on listing and entity page
checkOutcomes.evidence: The home listing and performer detail expose neither JSON-LD nor Open Graph metadata despite representing crawlable profile/media entities.

checkOutcomes.method: headers, cookies and secrets primitives
checkOutcomes.evidence: HTTPS is used and no sensitive secrets were found, but CSP/HSTS/nosniff are missing and three first-party analytics/ad cookies are not Secure.

checkOutcomes.method: tracker, HAR and cookie inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: The load contacts 11 third-party origins; 46/68 requests and 1.72 MB are third-party, with Google Analytics/GTM and ad-tech domains active before interaction.

checkOutcomes.method: load/DOM/Lighthouse inspection for prompts and auth surfaces
checkOutcomes.evidence: No geolocation/notification permission prompt fired on load, and no authentication flow exists on the covered public browsing templates.

checkOutcomes.method: security header and cookie inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: CSP/frame-ancestors or X-Frame-Options, HSTS, Referrer-Policy, and Permissions-Policy are all absent.

checkOutcomes.method: raw-HTML discoverability comparison with JavaScript disabled
checkOutcomes.evidence: Raw HTML contains 100% of rendered home content words and 99% on the performer detail; neither page is a JS shell.

checkOutcomes.method: repeated mobile menu toggling plus representative route/404 states
checkOutcomes.evidence: Ten open/close menu cycles left the DOM at 510 nodes, and listing/detail/error routes remained usable.

checkOutcomes.method: manifest/service-worker surface inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: This public media directory is content-oriented rather than an installed application, and exposes no manifest.
checkOutcomes.reason: Offline installability is not a proportionate requirement for this public media directory.

checkOutcomes.method: intentional HTTP 404 route
checkOutcomes.evidence: The server returns a real 404 and renders an explanatory recovery page with links to core sections.

checkOutcomes.method: document language/direction and language-switch inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: The English document has an empty html lang and dir even though it links an Español variant.

checkOutcomes.method: rendered detail data and locale-switch inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: Profile dates/durations are rendered as terse fixed strings such as 11y, 4y1m, 6y5m rather than locale-aware human-readable durations.

checkOutcomes.method: content/DOM inspection for time-specific events
checkOutcomes.evidence: Covered templates show relative post ages but no scheduled events, exact local times, or cross-zone coordination.
checkOutcomes.reason: No time-zone-sensitive event or exact time surface exists.

checkOutcomes.method: first-viewport screenshot, Lighthouse accessibility tree and third-party ad inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: Dating ads appear directly under Popular Videos before core content, while Lighthouse found an unnamed viewport-sized outbound ad link, making sponsorship and destination unclear.

checkOutcomes.method: form/flow inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: The only covered form is a search control with no required multi-field validation or user-data submission flow.
checkOutcomes.reason: No mistake-prone data-entry form is present on representative pages.

checkOutcomes.method: form input/autocomplete inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: There are no address, payment, sign-in, sign-up, or other personal-data fields requiring autofill tokens.
checkOutcomes.reason: Only a site search input is present; no personal-data input flow needs autofill assistance.

checkOutcomes.method: route and navigation inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: No checkout, subscription, consent, authentication, or account-management journey is exposed in the covered public browsing flow.
checkOutcomes.reason: The audited site surfaces no commercial or authenticated account flow.

checkOutcomes.method: image audit and HAR bytes
checkOutcomes.evidence: All 34 images lack srcset, 15 are oversized, 30 below-fold images are eager, and images transfer 1.35 MB.

checkOutcomes.method: HAR/tracker/trace inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: Ad and analytics requests begin on load across 11 third-party origins despite no user interaction; the main thread is light, but network background work is not.

checkOutcomes.method: HAR third-party/media budget inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: Third parties account for 1.72 MB and 46 requests, including 282 KB from GTM and 1.35 MB of third-party Twitter imagery.

checkOutcomes.method: robots and DOM inspection for agent-facing capability
checkOutcomes.evidence: Robots explicitly blocks major AI agents and this read-only directory declares no agentic actions or tools.
checkOutcomes.reason: The operator explicitly disallows AI crawlers and exposes no intended agent-facing action surface.

checkOutcomes.method: script/API inspection for built-in AI use cases
checkOutcomes.evidence: The site provides simple server-rendered browsing/search and has no summarisation or language-model workflow that needs on-device inference.
checkOutcomes.reason: No inference task is part of the product experience.

checkOutcomes.method: baseline/post heap snapshots after ten menu open/close cycles plus JS metrics
checkOutcomes.evidence: After ten cycles, heap nodes decreased 193,264→192,927, self size decreased 9,756,514→9,735,972 bytes, DOM stayed at 510 nodes, and used heap fell.

checkOutcomes.method: heap summary and Performance memory metrics
checkOutcomes.evidence: The page uses about 9.76 MB heap self size and 510 live DOM elements, proportionate to a 34-card media listing.

checkOutcomes.method: before/after heap constructor and DOM-count comparison
checkOutcomes.evidence: Neither heap summary reports Detached constructors, totals decreased after repeated toggles, and live DOM node count remained 510.

principleOutcomes.reason: All checks were judged not applicable to this site context.

paths.description: Homepage/top-performer listing: primary entry template, navigation, ads, pagination, preferences, performance, security, accessibility, and mobile/desktop adaptation.
Performer detail template: representative entity/profile and listing-to-detail core journey.
Popular videos listing: representative media index template on mobile.
Hashtag index: representative taxonomy/discovery template on mobile.
Intentional nonexistent route: HTTP failure and recovery-state template.

findings.evidence: The dark screenshot is identical to light and computed color-scheme is normal.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare light/dark support and retint surfaces with color-scheme and preference-aware tokens.

findings.evidence: No view-transition rules are present between listing and profile templates.
findings.suggestedFix: Add progressive cross-document View Transitions for listing-to-detail navigation.

findings.evidence: Long listing pages expose no sticky, shrinking, or progress-aware chrome.
findings.suggestedFix: Use lightweight sticky/scroll-state-aware navigation or a progress/back-to-top affordance.

findings.summary: Navigation does not cue where attention moved
findings.evidence: Listing-to-detail navigation offers no directional or target cue.
findings.suggestedFix: Use directional transitions and preserve/focus the destination heading.

findings.summary: Custom menu/search controls omit semantic state
findings.evidence: Icon buttons toggle custom UI without names or aria-expanded, and no native disclosure/popover primitive is used.
findings.suggestedFix: Use named buttons with aria-expanded/aria-controls and a native popover or appropriate disclosure primitive.

findings.evidence: Two dating ads sit between navigation and the page H1 in the first mobile viewport.
findings.suggestedFix: Defer and clearly label ads, and place the H1/core listing before non-essential promotional content.

findings.summary: Reusable cards rely only on viewport adaptation
findings.evidence: No container queries or container-type are present.
findings.suggestedFix: Make reusable media cards container-aware with @container while keeping the current fluid fallback.

findings.summary: Many controls are too small for touch
findings.evidence: Pagination links are 10–16 px wide and card labels are 18 px high.
findings.suggestedFix: Expand hit areas to at least 24x24 CSS px, preferably 44x44 for primary mobile controls.

findings.evidence: Lighthouse LCP is 3.46 s and trace LCP is 2.79 s.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritise the LCP image, lazy-load only below-fold media, and defer ad/analytics work.

findings.summary: Desktop load has a large layout shift
findings.evidence: Layout observation measured CLS 0.264 and all 34 images lack dimensions.
findings.suggestedFix: Reserve image/ad space with width/height or aspect-ratio and prevent late ad insertion from moving content.

findings.summary: Images are eagerly and non-responsively delivered
findings.evidence: 30 below-fold images are not lazy and every image lacks srcset.
findings.suggestedFix: Add responsive image candidates, explicit dimensions, and loading=lazy below the fold while prioritising LCP.

findings.summary: Third-party scripts dominate avoidable code cost
findings.evidence: GTM transfers 282 KB and several ad scripts run on initial load.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove redundant tags and load consented, value-bearing third parties conditionally after core content.

findings.summary: Core controls and ad embeds lack accessible names
findings.evidence: Two mobile buttons, an outbound ad link, an iframe, and search controls are unnamed.
findings.suggestedFix: Add explicit accessible names/titles and labels; keep decorative icons hidden from the accessibility tree.

findings.evidence: Pink links measure only 2.71:1 and 2.9:1 against light backgrounds.
findings.suggestedFix: Choose a darker brand token that reaches at least 4.5:1 in normal text states.

findings.evidence: No header, nav, main, or footer elements exist.
findings.suggestedFix: Wrap global navigation and primary content in semantic landmarks with a logical heading hierarchy.

findings.evidence: Many visible links remain under recommended target dimensions on mobile.
findings.suggestedFix: Increase target padding without changing visual density and re-test at narrow/zoomed layouts.

findings.summary: A failed image logs a console error
findings.evidence: A Twitter media URL returns 404 and appears in the console.
findings.suggestedFix: Handle unavailable media with a stable fallback and avoid requesting known-missing assets.

findings.evidence: All 34 images lack width/height and 15 are oversized.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit intrinsic dimensions/aspect-ratio and right-size responsive sources.

findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports three deprecation warnings and DevTools issues.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove deprecated integrations and resolve browser Issues panel findings, including third-party code where controllable.

findings.summary: Some navigation is not crawlable or named
findings.evidence: The language control uses javascript:void(0), four anchors omit href, and multiple image links are unnamed.
findings.suggestedFix: Use real href URLs and accessible descriptive link names for every destination.

findings.evidence: No canonical/hreflang appears and sitemap.xml returns 404.
findings.suggestedFix: Publish canonical URLs, hreflang for the Spanish variant, and a current sitemap referenced by robots.txt.

findings.evidence: No JSON-LD or Open Graph metadata describes profile/media entities.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate schema.org JSON-LD and Open Graph tags aligned with visible content.

findings.summary: Transport defenses and cookie flags are weak
findings.evidence: CSP, HSTS, and nosniff are missing; three long-lived analytics/ad cookies lack Secure.
findings.suggestedFix: Set defensive headers and mark HTTPS cookies Secure with the narrowest viable SameSite and lifetime.

findings.summary: Initial load has a broad tracking footprint
findings.evidence: Eleven third-party origins receive 46 requests and 1.72 MB before interaction.
findings.suggestedFix: Minimise vendors, gate non-essential analytics/ads behind informed choice, and batch remaining telemetry.

findings.evidence: No clickjacking policy, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, CSP, or HSTS is present.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy CSP with frame-ancestors plus HSTS, nosniff, Referrer-Policy, and a restrictive Permissions-Policy.

findings.evidence: html lang and dir are empty despite an English page and Spanish variant.
findings.suggestedFix: Set lang=en and an appropriate dir; add correct language metadata on every localized page.

findings.evidence: Strings such as 11y and 4y1m are terse fixed abbreviations.
findings.suggestedFix: Format durations with locale-aware wording and expose machine-readable dates where available.

findings.summary: Advertising destination and sponsorship are unclear
findings.evidence: Dating ads precede content and Lighthouse detects an unnamed viewport-sized outbound ad link.
findings.suggestedFix: Clearly label sponsored placements, remove deceptive full-area links/popunders, and keep destinations predictable.

findings.summary: Media assets are not proportionately optimised
findings.evidence: Images transfer 1.35 MB; all lack srcset, 15 are oversized, and 30 below-fold images load eagerly.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve right-sized responsive images and lazy-load offscreen media.

findings.summary: Background network work starts without user value
findings.evidence: Ad and analytics calls fan out to 11 third-party origins on load.
findings.suggestedFix: Deprioritise and conditionally initiate background fetches after core content and user choice.

findings.evidence: Third parties account for 85% of transferred bytes and 46 of 68 requests.
findings.suggestedFix: Set and enforce a third-party byte/request budget; remove or defer vendors that do not improve the core browse task.

taskList.title: Fix intrinsic media sizing, responsive delivery, and lazy loading
Add accessible names, landmarks, contrast, and target sizing
Reduce and gate ad/analytics third parties
Deploy security headers and secure cookie policy
Repair canonical, crawlable, language, and rich metadata
Respect color scheme and modernise navigation state
Clean console, deprecated APIs, and failed resources
